bio_en: Sedo Muratian was born around 1850 in Aragh, a village of seventy families in the Mush plain, the eldest of four sons of the miller Murat, whose mill sheltered revolutionaries such as Arabo and Mkho Shahen. From 1885, on Hrayr's instructions, he carried messages to the princes of Sasun - Grgo of Shenik, Peto of Geliguzan, Gaspar of Talvorik - and he linked Margar Varzhapet's ARF band with the region in 1891. He went on to serve as courier for Abro, Aram Aramian, Hrayr, Turpakh and Aghbyur Serob, and remained active up to the 1904 Sasun uprising. He died in exile, where young Armenians carried his coffin to the grave.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Birth year approximate (c.1850); death year and place not stated in the archive text.
